notes.title: Game update
notes.notes:
We moved the game on the updated engine version. This should improve performance and fix some bugs. Russian language typos fix. 
Please do remember to exit all applications before running the game if you got less than 4MB RAM on your computer. Please update all drivers include Direct X and your graphical card drivers. 
Thank you for your patience!

notes.title: Release and Russian language fixes!
notes.notes:
Hello friends~
We are glad to announce that the game is now released. 
All the typos in the Russian language were fixed and ready to play. 
We are still waiting for the Steam support to help us with Achievements. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Release news!
notes.notes:
Hello, everybody.
We have some wonderful news for you: the QA testing for Love Ritual is complete and the game is ready for release. All that's left is to add Spanish and Russian translations and wait for Steam's approval! We eagerly await this moment, because we want to share our visual novel experience with all of you as soon as possible.
Best regards,

-Xand Arts

notes.title: Demo release!
notes.notes:
We are glad to announce that the "Love Ritual" demo is finally available on Steam! You can push the 'Download Demo' button and try the game for yourself!

Please feel free to add your screenshots or start new threads on the forum with questions, and we will gladly discuss the game with you!

Enjoy!
